ev.q: to report unweighted counts, aggregated by school type, to CDC via a web-based questionnaire in the Secure Access Management system
CDC uses these counts to produce state- and national-level estimates of vaccination coverage among children in kindergarten.

changes.why: State immunization programs are the jurisdictions feeding CDC's national school vaccination assessment, so they are not listed separately; no state system's own data are analysed apart from the national report.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analysed; kindergarten age defines the population, and school type and state are not SPDs.
